title: CYBRIK investigation evidence v1
description: A single piece of evidence collected within an investigation. Evidence is a REFERENCE to a product-owned object (source_ref, digest-bound), never an inlined copy — the platform dereferences it through the owner's authorized API (strategy 05 §4.5), mirroring the inference packet's context_refs/alert_refs pattern. `excerpt` is a short human-readable pointer only, bounded to discourage inlining raw content. Evidence carries NO tool/capability/delegation/approval/action field — collecting evidence is descriptive, never itself an execution-authority grant (disjoint from ADR-0004, same TI-2 stance as the accepted W2-D inference packet). Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA) by explicit Founder Option A and G-W0I01-1..5=yes on 2026-07-26.

evidence_digest.description: Content digest of this evidence record itself (distinct from source_ref.digest, which digests the referenced product-owned object). This is the digest a claim's evidence_refs and a bundle's evidence[] cite (structural replay/citation-dereference anchor).

investigation_id.description: Parent cybrik.investigation.v1.investigation_id. Required — evidence is always investigation-scoped (ADR-0006 E6).

source_ref.description: Digest-bound reference to the underlying product-owned object (e.g. a soc.alert, a tool-execution-result artifact, an ocsf.event). Dereferenced through the owner's authorized API, never inlined; NOT the digest a claim's evidence_refs cites (that is evidence_digest, this record's own content digest — see TR-3 citation-dereference invariant).

excerpt.description: Optional short human-readable pointer into source_ref (e.g. a one-line log snippet). NOT the authoritative content — a full copy is dereferenced through the owner's API, never carried here.

receipt_ref.description: Optional digest of the cybrik.execution-receipt.v1 (receipt_digest) that produced this evidence via a tool execution, tying evidence provenance back to the signed receipt chain (ADR-0004 F6 / ADR-0006 E5).

collected_by.description: Authenticated actor (service or agent) that collected this evidence. Written only by authenticated service code.
